content: jsqr@1.4.0: pure-JS, zero-dependency QR decoder. jsQR(imageData, width, height, options?) takes a Uint8ClampedArray of RGBA pixel data (length 4*width*height, same shape as browser ImageData / Node raw pixel buffers) and returns {data, binaryData, location} or null. Ships its own dist/index.d.ts (no @types package needed). Well-suited for headless Vitest decode-round-trip assertions since it needs no canvas/DOM.
